entity: Snapfinger Creek plant's overflows vs penalties (1,394 overflows, $52,344, about $38 each)
why: The overflow claim matches the press (chronic Snapfinger-basin spills). The penalty claim breaks: EPA says $859K in stipulated penalties were paid for these SSOs plus a $1M fine, and $294K in 2017; the $38-each framing rests on a slice of the real penalties.
